completion_blockers.title: 실제 owner/self pilot transcript evidence is still missing

completion_blockers.title: Learning outcome claims remain intentionally blocked
completion_blockers.required_to_complete_goal: Do not claim fluency, retention, realtime voice efficacy, or generated-media learning gains until real evidence supports the claim.
